title: Product Recall Checker input
description: Check one item or up to 100 items against public CPSC, NHTSA and FDA recall records. Each completed query costs $0.01; source-outage-only results are not charged.

barcode.title: Barcode / UPC
barcode.description: UPC, EAN or GTIN digits for one item.

brand.title: Brand or vehicle make
brand.description: Product brand, or vehicle make when checking NHTSA.

product_name.title: Product name
product_name.description: Product name to search public recall listings.

year.title: Model year
year.description: Optional vehicle model year. NHTSA vehicle recall search requires a year.

queries.title: Batch of items
queries.description: Optional list of 1 to 100 items. Each item can contain barcode, brand, model, product_name and year.
